about: Spells a player can aim at a squad mate. To the game a squad mate is an NPC in your party (like a Trust), and it only lets you pick one as the target of a spell whose own target list includes NPCs. Cure, Protect, Shell, Haste and the -na spells have that; the party-only spells here do not. The launcher adds the NPC target to each spell listed, in the game's spell table (the mgc_ part of ROM/118/114.DAT). 'targets' is what the spell has before the change (1 = yourself, 4 = party member); a spell with any other value is left alone. Yourself and party members stay valid targets: the NPC target is only added. Left out on purpose: Sneak, Invisible, Deodorize and Warp II (no use on a mate), the songs that need Pianissimo, and spells later than the era.
about_abilities: Job abilities work the same way, in the comm part of the same file (48 bytes an ability; a job ability's entry is its id + 512). 'targets' as for spells: 4 = party member, 5 = yourself or a party member. Cover, Accomplice and Collaborator also need the server to let a squad mate through (server: modules/custom/late/squad_abilities.lua, and battleutils.cpp for Cover). Curing Waltz already has the NPC target. Left out: Divine Waltz (cast around yourself) and abilities later than the era.
